message.publisher: Bernoulli Society for Mathematical Statistics and Probability
message.abstract: <jats:p>Let $X$ be an absolutely continuous random variable from the integrated Pearson family and assume that $X$ has finite moments of any order. Using some properties of the associated orthonormal polynomial system, we provide a class of strengthened Chernoff-type variance bounds.</jats:p>
title: Strengthened Chernoff-type variance bounds
